prose.body:
Hi Eastgate Clinics AP team,

We noticed a discrepancy in the payout account on file for Invoice INV-87237 ($7,061.11 USDC). Our finance team updated our primary receiving address to reflect our new treasury structure. Please ensure the payment is sent to the updated account below to avoid processing delays.

New Payout Account: rowanfacilities12_.testnet

Please confirm once the transfer has been initiated. This update applies to all pending invoices with Rowan Facilities.

Best regards,
Rowan Facilities Accounts Receivable
